On this page
GET Margin Snapshots
NT8
Tradovate
Margin snapshots TRADOVATE​

Returns one {environment, userId, name, data} envelope for every linked identity. Each envelope's inner data array contains raw Tradovate /marginSnapshot/list rows: initial and maintenance margin, total used margin, and liquidation thresholds (autoLiqLevel, liqOnlyLevel) as Tradovate reports them. CrossTrade passes these fields through unchanged and does not compute them.

Endpoint​

GET /v1/api/tv/marginsnapshots

Headers​
NAME	VALUE
Content-Type	application/json
Authorization	Bearer <token>
Code examples​
Python
JavaScript
cURL
import requests



token = 'my-secret-token'



url = "https://app.crosstrade.io/v1/api/tv/marginsnapshots"

headers = {

    "Authorization": f"Bearer {token}",

    "Content-Type": "application/json"

}



response = requests.get(url, headers=headers)

print(f"Response Code: {response.status_code}, Response Text: {response.text}")

200
401

  "success": true,

  "data": [

    {

      "environment": "demo",

      "data": [

        {

          "id": 123456,

          "timestamp": "2026-07-15T14:32:05.184Z",

          "riskTimePeriodId": 9,

          "initialMargin": 1760.00,

          "maintenanceMargin": 1600.00,

          "totalUsedMargin": 1600.00,

          "fullInitialMargin": 1760.00,

          "autoLiqLevel": -2000,

          "liqOnlyLevel": -2000,

          "positionMargin": 1600,

        }

  ]

}

Success field types​
FIELD	TYPE	DESCRIPTION
success	boolean	Outer request status.
data	array of objects	Identity envelopes.
data[].environment, data[].userId, data[].name	string	Environment, identity ID and display name.
data[].data	array of objects or object	Margin rows, or an error object.
data[].data.error	string	Identity read failure.
data[].data[].id, data[].data[].riskTimePeriodId	integer	Snapshot and risk-period IDs.
data[].data[].timestamp	string	ISO 8601 timestamp.
data[].data[].initialMargin, data[].data[].maintenanceMargin, data[].data[].fullInitialMargin, data[].data[].positionMargin	float	Margin requirements.
data[].data[].totalUsedMargin, data[].data[].totalUsedFullMargin, data[].data[].openCollateralReq	float	Margin usage and collateral requirement.
data[].data[].autoLiqLevel, data[].data[].liqOnlyLevel	float	Liquidation thresholds.
Platform nuances​

Authentication uses the same bearer token as the rest of the CrossTrade API and requires a plan with API access (Pro) plus a linked Tradovate account. Unlinked users receive 403 tradovate_not_linked.

This endpoint is REST-only and has no WebSocket equivalent.
